vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, gaṇhāhi, ānanda, nisīdanaṃ. yena pāvālacetiyaṃ ten'upasaṅkamissāma divāvihārāyā'ti.

kadā nu maṃ pāvusakālamegho, navena toyena sacīvaraṃ vane, isippayātamhi pathe vajantaṃ, ovassate taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

45948.meaning1: grove showered (by rain) in the monsoon

examples.text: varāha-eṇeyya-vigāḷha-sevite, pabbhārakuṭṭe pakat'eva sundare, nav'ambunā pāvusasitthakānane, tahiṃ guhāgehagato ramissasi.

45949.commentary: (THa) pāvus'ābbhamālinin'ti evaṃ pāvusakāle samantato sumālinīhi thalajajalajamālāhi samannāgatattā abbhamāliniṃ janavivittatāya manoramatāya ca rammaṃ pabbataṃ labhitvā tattha nage ramissaṃ

examples.text: migo yathā seri sucittakānane, rammaṃ giriṃ pāvus'ābbhamāliniṃ, anākule tattha nage ramissaṃ, asaṃsayaṃ citta parābhavissasi.

atha kho taṃ, bhikkhave, māluvābījaṃ n'eva moro gileyya, na mago khādeyya, na davaḍāho ḍaheyya, na vanakammikā uddhareyyuṃ, na upacikā uṭṭhaheyyuṃ, bījañ'ca pan'assa taṃ pāvussakena meghena abhippavuṭṭhaṃ samma'd'eva viruheyya.

atha kho pāveyyakā mallā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ, bhagavā'pi khattiyo mayam'pi khattiyā, mayam'pi arahāma bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, mayam'pi bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ'ca mahañ'ca karissāmā'ti.

na ca kiñci loke upādiyatī'ti lokasmiṃ kiñci rūpaṃ vā… viññāṇaṃ vā ayaṃ me attā vā attaniyaṃ vā'ti na gaṇhāti. evam'pī'ti upariatthaṃ upādāya sampiṇḍan'attho pikāro. iminā pana padena bhagavā ān'āpānapabbadesanaṃ niyyātetvā dasseti.
upako palagaṇḍo ca, pukkusāti ca te tayo, bhaddiyo khaṇḍadevo ca, bahudantī ca piṅgayo, te hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ, dibbayogaṃ upaccagun'ti.

45979.commentary: (SNa) piṅgalā'ti kaḷārapiṅgalā. (SNt) kaḷārapiṅgalā'ti nikkhantapiṅgal'akkhikā, kaḷārapiṅgalā'ti vā rattagattā ca piṅgalacakkhukā ca.

examples.text: na hi nūn'imassa samaṇassa, piṅgalā tilakāhatā, sottaṃ pādena bodheti, ten'āyaṃ samaṇo sukhī.

45980.meaning1: name of a type of elephant

examples.text: yaṃ dasannaṃ tambānaṃ, taṃ ekassa piṅgalassa. yaṃ dasannaṃ piṅgalānaṃ, taṃ ekassa gandhahatthino. yaṃ dasannaṃ gandhahatthīnaṃ, taṃ ekassa maṅgalassa.

45981.commentary: (MNa) piṅgalakoccho'ti so brāhmaṇo piṅgaladhātuko. koccho'ti pan'assa nāmaṃ, tasmā piṅgalakoccho'ti vuccati.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. atha kho piṅgalakoccho brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
upako palagaṇḍo ca, pukkusāti ca te tayo, bhaddiyo khaṇḍadevo ca, bāhudantī ca piṅgiyo, te hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ, dibbayogaṃ upaccagun'ti.

45986.commentary: (ANa) piṅgiyāniṃ brāhmaṇan'ti evaṃnāmakaṃ anāgāmiphale patiṭṭhitaṃ ariyasāvakaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ. so kira pāto'va uṭṭhāya gandhamāl'ādīni gāhāpetvā satthu santikaṃ gantvā vanditvā gandhamāl'ādīhi pūjetvā nagaraṃ āgacchati, idaṃ brāhmaṇassa devasikaṃ vattanti. taṃ so evaṃ vattaṃ katvā āgacchantaṃ addasa.

examples.text: addasā kho kāraṇapālī brāhmaṇo piṅgiyāniṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ, disvā piṅgiyāniṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca
idha me etadahosi, acchariyaṃ yāva lūkh'āyaṃ dharaṇī, yatra hi nāma imaṃ chaḍḍanīyadhammaṃ sappiṃ picunā gāhāpessati. bahukāni ca me mah'agghāni bhesajjāni upagatāni.

45994.commentary: (VINa) morapiñchaparisibbitā'ti talesu vā vaddhesu vā morapiñchehi suttakasadisehi parisibbitā.

examples.text: na, bhikkhave, khallakabaddhā upāhanā dhāretabbā… na ajavisāṇavaddhikā upāhanā dhāretabbā, na vicchikāḷikā upāhanā dhāretabbā, na morapiñchaparisibbitā upāhanā dhāretabbā, na citrā upāhanā dhāretabbā.

atha puriso āgaccheyya kuddālapiṭakaṃ ādāya. so taṃ māluvālataṃ mūle chindeyya, mūle chetvā palikhaṇeyya, palikhaṇitvā mūlāni uddhareyya, antamaso usīranāḷamattāni'pi.
seyyathā'pi, devānam'inda, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre mahādhaññarāsi. tato mahājanakāyo dhaññaṃ āhareyya, kājehi'pi piṭakehi'pi ucchaṅgehi'pi añjalīhi'pi.
